summary: The server install script sets origin to the kyrox-studio organization; the repository moved from hinthorozu and should not rely on GitHub's redirect.

impactAnalysis.notes: One remote URL string in a server install script. No application runtime, API, persistence, BOM, item definition or migration change.

e2e.reason: Server install script only; no browser-visible behavior changes.

risk.notes: Servers that run the script now fetch over SSH from git@github.com:kyrox-studio/fair-stand.git; the deploy key must have access to the moved repository.

rollback: Revert the remote URL in scripts/install-server.sh.
